title: Energy mix, transitions and carbon lock-in

source.request:
Energy transition and carbon lock in at plant level
Construct firm energy mix per year: coal, diesel/fuel oil, gas/lpg, electicity pln, non pln, self generation, biomass. 

Classify firm menjadi coal-intensive, oil intensive, gas intensive, electricity intensive, mixed.

Buat transition matrix 2010-22 dan cek siapa yg successfully switch keluar dari high carbon fuel dan siapa yg ttp carbon-locked.
Grafik by sectors

question: Pabrik mana memakai campuran energi yang sama terus-menerus, dan mana yang berpindah ke campuran lain?
rationale: Answer the exact Word row with independently auditable quantities and an accessible report.
scope: Describe annual fuel mixes, dominant input-energy classes and observed endpoint switches from 2010 to 2022, with sector detail. Real plant links are required only for switches; changing annual sample composition is described separately.
unit_of_analysis: Source observation keyed by source_year/source_row; annual grouped aggregates. Verified plant endpoint pairs are a separate gated transition branch.

decisions.selected_rule: High-carbon fuel classes are coal or oil/diesel for this descriptive flag. Persistence means the same/high-carbon class at both observed endpoints. decisions.rationale: Energy-class switches do not identify fuel-specific emissions, power-source carbon or what happened in unobserved years.
